description: Adds time to the driver's active hourly parking, once the driver pays for it. No API key needed. Requires phone_code (the 6-character code on the driver's receipt or pass), plate_last3 (the last 3 characters of the plate) and extend_hours (0.5 to 8, in half-hour steps); session_id with session_code works in place of the two codes. Returns the price, the new end time once paid and a pay_url to the driver's session page, where the driver pays. Nothing is charged and the end time doesn't move until the driver pays there. Any mismatch returns the same answer, SESSION_NOT_FOUND. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

extend_hours.description: Hours to add: 0.5 to 8, in half-hour steps

phone_code.description: The 6-character phone code printed on the driver's receipt or pass

plate_last3.description: The last 3 letters or numbers of the license plate parked on the session

session_id.description: Session id, from the driver's session page link. Sent with session_code in place of the phone code.

name: extend_session
title: Extend a parking session
